-- Pasted from the PostgreSQL warehouse. It fails in SQLite: port it.
-- grain: one row per month, Dubai customers, 2025, non-cancelled orders
SELECT
  to_char(date_trunc('month', o.order_date::timestamp), 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.channel ILIKE 'MOBILE%') AS app_orders
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.city ILIKE 'dubai'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
solution:
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.channel LIKE 'MOBILE%') AS app_orders
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE c.city LIKE 'dubai'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
